name: Vrikshasana
description: A classic standing balance pose. Vrikshasana improves focus, concentration, and balance while strengthening the legs.

steps.instruction: Stand tall with feet together, arms relaxed by your sides.
steps.voice_prompt: Stand tall with your feet together, arms relaxed at your sides, and gaze forward.

steps.instruction: Shift your weight onto your left leg, finding stability.
steps.voice_prompt: Shift your weight slowly onto your left leg, keeping it strong and grounded.

steps.instruction: Lift your right foot and place it against your inner left thigh.
steps.voice_prompt: Lift your right foot and place it on your inner left thigh. Avoid placing it on the knee joint.

steps.instruction: Bring your hands together in prayer position in front of your chest.
steps.voice_prompt: Join your palms in front of your chest in prayer pose, finding your balance.

steps.instruction: Inhale, raise your arms overhead, and hold your balance.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale, stretch your arms straight overhead, open your chest, and hold your balance.
